ideas.pitch: A mobile web app that tracks school carpooling and bus routes to compute carbon savings and alert parents on real-time arrival safety.
ideas.title: SchoolCommute Carbon & Safety Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to school judges and mentors looking for local, everyday impact with quantifiable environmental metrics, mirroring the civic-tech approach seen in past winning projects.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered web tool that turns complex textbook PDFs into simplified notes and audio explanations in regional Indian languages for school students.
ideas.title: EduScribe Multilingual Study Notes Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a relatable educational pain point for school students and teachers, emphasizing accessibility and practical classroom utility.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision checklist application that uses webcams to verify if school students are wearing proper safety goggles and lab coats before chemistry experiments.
ideas.title: LabSafety AI Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a live, working computer vision demo that solves a tangible safety hazard in high school science laboratories, scoring high on novelty for an inter-school crowd.

ideas.pitch: A smart image-matching repository for school lost-and-found items using visual embeddings to automatically pair lost items with reported missing descriptions.
ideas.title: CampusLost&Found AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an immediately deployable utility for the host institute and participating schools, ensuring a high-impact demo that judges can test instantly on their own items.

ideas.pitch: A quick-capture web app designed for school canteens and tiffin boxes to analyze nutritional balance and give instant health scores.
ideas.title: NutriTiffin Meal Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into student health and wellness themes with a polished, consumer-friendly interface that is easy to demo live during judging rounds.
